'''Magister Impressor''' was a rank in the slaver organization [[The Crucible|Crucible]], which kidnapped beings from across the galaxy and forced them to fight each other in the combat. The Magister Impressor oversaw the capture of new recruits, placement of successful trainees and disposal of the failures. In [[3963 BBY]] the rank was held by [[Chantique]].
